notes.title: Preferences Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Everyone![/h1]

After a long break, finally, there is a new update! This update has been made entirely based on both good and bad reviews on our Steam Page. So if you think there should be an improvement on something or you just like the game etc. you can write a review because we read them all! Here are the changes that are coming with this update:

[h2]1- Preferences[/h2]

Now game remembers 3 essential things from your past: 

[olist]
[*] Apple skin
[*] Game window's resolution
[*] Language
[/olist]

Whenever you close and open the game these attributes will be remembered and you will continue where you left off with the same Apple skin, resolution, and language. This adjustment was the number 1 asked thing in the reviews.

[h2]2- News Texts[/h2]

Added 2 new news texts. And 2 of them came from our mail: applesthegame@gmail.com . So if you want to write something in the news text, just mail me and maybe in the future, it will be there.

[h2]3- New Apples[/h2]

Added Santa Apple, Goku Apple, and Sailor Apple.

[h2]4- Cursor[/h2]

Added new cursor. (Hope you like it.)

[h2]5- Mac support[/h2]

Added Mac support for both types of computers that contain silicon and Intel CPUs.

[h2]6- Bug & Typos[/h2]

Bugs fixed and typos corrected.

notes.title: Score Update
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, After the release the game had some big changes, This update announcement is about them.

[h1]Changes: [/h1]

[olist]
[*] [h2]Anti-Cheat[/h2]
Added an Anti-Cheat system to the game. This anti-cheat is for score and leaderboard. (Drops can not be cheated because they are protected via Steam server side.)

[*] [h2]Cloud Save[/h2]
Added Cloud Saves to the game. Now your score will stay even if you quit the game. So you can reach 10M clicks (highest achievement) without worrying about closing the game.

[*] [h2]Drop Times[/h2]
Drop times have been updated. Now You can drop a maximum of 11 apples per day and every 130 minutes. This was 12 apples and 120 minutes but since there is deflation of the apples in the market right now, so to prevent deflation this has been made. Also Every week on Monday this time will change. 

Here is the plan:
22 July: 130 minutes
29 July: 135 minutes
5 August: 140 minutes
12 August: 145 minutes
19 August: 150 minutes

after that 150 minutes will stay. (This can be changed.)

So if you are early you will have more apples per hour.

[*] [h2]Drops ratios[/h2]

Since higher-tier apples are in the market very fast. With the new update, their drop rates are now reduced. So tier 6,7,8's drop rates are reduced and tier 9,10's drop rates are reduced drastically. Note: Crates have a higher chance of dropping upper-tier apples.

[*] [h2]New Apples[/h2]

1- Pacman Apple
2- Samurai Apple
3- Path Apple
4- Eye apple
5- Moon Apple
6- Graduated Apple
7- Catch-Ball Apple
8- Ring Apple
9- Neon Apple
10- Acrylic Apple 
11- Yin and Yang Apple (Community Made)

even though now tier 1-5 apples are more common with the new update 10 new apples are added to the game so you won't get the same apples every drop. This update has been made because the game shouldn't be boring.

Also, all apples can be found here: https://steamdb.info/app/3066470/items/

[*] [h2]News:[/h2]

One of the coolest features in the game is definitely the News or the scrolling texts. Here is the content of the News:

1- Free Steam games (very rare)
2- Funny Jokes
3- Encrypted Messages
4- Lore
5- References
6- Pranks
7- Interesting things
8- Suggestions

etc.

[*] [h2]Leaderboard[/h2]

Every week on Sunday leaderboard's top 10 people will be displayed on both the store page and in Discord. Also, they can get their role @Achievement Unlocked from Discord support. (On Sunday 28 July the leaderboard will be reset for the first and probably the last time.)

[/olist]

If you have any questions come to [url=https://discord.gg/5xjKBwckCE]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: The Skin Update
notes.content:
[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Clickable Apple Skins can now be changed via the Skin Menu. All you have to do is open the skin menu, write the [b]exact[/b] name of the apple to the text bar, and hit the [b]Change[/b] button to change the skin.

[*] Added 1 Steam Key to the news messages it has a 1/12500 chance to appear for every news message. The Steam key contains random Steam Game. If you are the first one to see and claim it then notify us on our Discord Server so I can put in a new key.

[*] The game has been optimized.

[*] Added FPS chooser. Now you can choose the fps you want to play to increase performance or the quality.

[*] Added sound effect to opening a crate.

[*] One of the news messages was incorrect, but it was fixed with the right one. (The message that wants you to decode something.)
[/list]
